items.stem: A firm is opening a new branch. Activities: A Design (3 weeks, no predecessor); B Order equipment (6 weeks, after A); C Recruit staff (3 weeks, after A); D Install equipment (4 weeks, after B); E Train staff (7 weeks, after C); G Test systems (3 weeks, after B); F Launch (2 weeks, after D, E, G). Calculate the earliest start time of each activity, the minimum project duration and the critical path, and the total float of each non-critical activity.
items.answer: Earliest start times: A 0, B 3, C 3, D 9, E 6, G 9, F 13. Minimum duration = 15 weeks. Critical path: A–B–D–F and A–C–E–F. Float: G 1 week.
items.markingKey: EST = latest finish of preceding activities; LFT worked backwards; total float = LFT − duration − EST; critical activities have zero float. [M1] for a correct formula/method with substituted values; [A1] for duration 15 weeks and the critical path. Units (%, $, days, times) required for [A1]. Apply own figure rule (OFR) to later parts.

items.stem: A firm is opening a new branch. Activities: A Design (4 weeks, no predecessor); B Order equipment (4 weeks, after A); C Recruit staff (3 weeks, after A); D Install equipment (6 weeks, after B); E Train staff (5 weeks, after C); G Test systems (2 weeks, after B); F Launch (1 week, after D, E, G). Calculate the earliest start time of each activity, the minimum project duration and the critical path, and the total float of each non-critical activity.
items.answer: Earliest start times: A 0, B 4, C 4, D 8, E 7, G 8, F 14. Minimum duration = 15 weeks. Critical path: A–B–D–F. Float: C 2 weeks, E 2 weeks, G 4 weeks.
items.markingKey: EST = latest finish of preceding activities; LFT worked backwards; total float = LFT − duration − EST; critical activities have zero float. [M1] for a correct formula/method with substituted values; [A1] for duration 15 weeks and the critical path. Units (%, $, days, times) required for [A1]. Apply own figure rule (OFR) to later parts.
